model.note: The weights are not in the repository. They are in the long-windows archive of the release.
model.optimizer: Adam in the eigenbasis of each weight matrix's gradient moments, refreshed every 50 updates, the matrices of three-dimensional weights turned as well
model.training_windows: 512 bytes in batches of 8 up to 24,000 updates, then 1,024 bytes in batches of 4 with a read reach of 1,024 cells; 4,096 targets an update throughout

architecture.stack: eleven levels, each a state read of 8 heads and then a layer of threshold cells, both writing their spikes back into one stream of 512 channels
architecture.cell_fibres: every channel now and once more after one to three bytes
architecture.read_tag_fibres: every channel now and once more after one to three bytes
architecture.pool: threshold quanta 16 times finer than v14, a rest of 4 quanta, one pool spike for every 64 pulses of the stream; the output neurons have a pool with 128 quanta to a threshold

enwik8_test.over: the reference Transformer in warmed windows of 496 bytes of history before 16 scored, along the same streams, with fast output synapses at a rate of 0.07
